description: Everything recorded about one tool: why its calls failed and the commonest error messages, which arguments the server refused, its parameters, how large its answers are, when its definition changed, how often agents repeated a call, and which call came right before the ones that repeated or failed.

days.description: How many days back to look, ending now. 7 when left out. Ignored when from is given.

from.description: Start of the window, as an ISO 8601 date or time. Overrides days.

server.description: The MCP server to ask about, by name or id. Leave out when the account has only one.

to.description: End of the window, as an ISO 8601 date or time. Now when left out.

tool.description: The tool's name, as list_tools gives it.

name: get_tool
title: Tool details
